scope: Natural-language semantic relation revision, reflective optimization, and world-model hypothesis learning.

hswm_research_order.W1: Oracle local execution is first; demonstrate fresh local LLM use of canonical relation text, ordered typed roles, context and exceptions against predeclared outcome and controls.
hswm_research_order.W2: Candidate-revision schema/evaluator design may proceed in parallel, but W2 efficacy evaluation begins only after W1 passes; no scale/topology intervention may rescue W1 failure.

sources.title: Verbalized Machine Learning: Revisiting Machine Learning with Language Models
sources.authors: Tim Z. Xiao; Robert Bamler; Bernhard Schölkopf; Weiyang Liu
sources.publication_status: Transactions on Machine Learning Research, 2025; arXiv version
sources.scope_read: Full method §3, applications/failure cases, current limitations, and relevant appendices listed by the HTML paper.
sources.objective_algorithm: A frozen LLM is a learner function parameterized by natural-language theta; an optimizer LLM consumes batches of inputs, learner predictions, labels, current theta, and optimizer settings to produce revised theta.
sources.reported_result_population: Regression and classification case studies, principally low-dimensional inputs; not a relation-revision benchmark.
sources.assumptions_failures: Labelled examples and optimizer prompt/model capability; reported variance, context-window limits, local minima, high-dimensional text-encoding difficulty, and failures to learn desired patterns.
sources.hswm_transfer_obligation: Treat semanticText/disposition changes as auditable candidate relation revisions with role, exception, evidence, owner and lineage preservation; test independent outcomes rather than relabeling prompt updates as learning.

sources.title: TextGrad: Automatic Differentiation via Text
sources.authors: Mert Yuksekgonul; Federico Bianchi; Joseph Boen; Sheng Liu; Zhi Huang; Carlos Guestrin; James Zou
sources.scope_read: Full method, results, and limitations in arXiv HTML; Nature record checked for publication status.
sources.objective_algorithm: Build a computation graph, collect LLM textual feedback from each successor context, aggregate it as a textual gradient, then use Textual Gradient Descent to rewrite selected variables.
sources.reported_result_population: Task-specific reasoning, coding, molecule and treatment-plan demonstrations; scientific applications are proof-of-concept.
sources.assumptions_failures: Feedback quality and LLM optimizer reliability; method calls its scientific applications proof-of-concept and calls for stability/variance reduction and external experimental validation.
sources.hswm_transfer_obligation: Use feedback as a proposal diagnostic, not a derivative, truth signal, or causal credit. Bind each revision to independently observed outcome and held-out comparison.

sources.title: Optimizing Instructions and Demonstrations for Multi-Stage Language Model Programs
sources.authors: Krista Opsahl-Ong; Michael J. Ryan; Josh Purtell; David Broman; Christopher Potts; Matei Zaharia; Omar Khattab
sources.scope_read: Full optimization method §§3–4, experiments/findings, and limitations.
sources.objective_algorithm: Generate grounded instruction and demonstration candidates per module; use minibatch scores and a TPE Bayesian surrogate to select joint program parameterizations; periodically full-evaluate candidates.
sources.reported_result_population: Evaluated on seven multi-stage LM-program settings; results concern instruction/demo optimization, not relation revision.
sources.assumptions_failures: Fixed task/proposer models and budgets; handwritten seed prompt; authors state the approach has restricted ability to infer complex governing rules.
sources.hswm_transfer_obligation: Separate revision proposal from credit assignment. A global downstream metric is insufficient evidence that one relation semantic delta is useful or causal.

sources.title: GEPA: Reflective Prompt Evolution Can Outperform Reinforcement Learning
sources.publication_status: ICLR 2026 Oral; paper also on arXiv
sources.implementation_version_observed: GitHub main branch inspected 2026-09-22; no release tag used or claimed.
sources.scope_read: Full Algorithm 1/2, feedback/evaluation method, reported result sections, and official implementation README/API surface.
sources.objective_algorithm: Execute system candidates on feedback minibatches, combine numeric evaluation with trajectory/evaluator text, reflectively mutate one module prompt, admit minibatch-improved candidates, and select through an instance-wise Pareto frontier held on a separate split.
sources.reported_result_population: Six prompt/system optimization tasks; all results are authors' task-metric results, not HSWM evidence.
sources.assumptions_failures: Requires a task metric/feedback function and a budgeted train/feedback/Pareto split; reflection and evaluator text do not establish truth, causal attribution, or transferable semantic knowledge.
sources.hswm_transfer_obligation: Adopt only the explicit proposal-to-selection ledger and split discipline. Canonical admission still requires owner/provenance/authority checks and independently observed outcome; reflection alone cannot revise HSWM state.

sources.title: Generating Symbolic World Models via Test-time Scaling of Large Language Models
sources.publication_status: Transactions on Machine Learning Research, 2025; arXiv version
sources.scope_read: Full proposed method §3, experimental discussion, and stated limitations.
sources.objective_algorithm: Use best-of-N log-likelihood selection to initialize candidate PDDL domains, then alternate an LLM optimizer critique and LLM updater to revise PDDL and reasoning text; plan with A* after synthesis.
sources.reported_result_population: PDDL synthesis and planning experiments under fully observable, noise-free simulated settings.
sources.assumptions_failures: Formal validator checks syntax/executability rather than semantic intent; experiments assume fully observable, noise-free, perfectly executing simulation.
sources.hswm_transfer_obligation: A formal fixture can test selected relation constraints, but must not replace relation text, ordered roles, exceptions, evidence, or observed external outcomes with a fixed routing DSL.

sources.title: Learning POMDP World Models from Observations with Language-Model Priors
sources.implementation_version_observed: GitHub main branch inspected 2026-09-22; repository showed four commits, no release, MIT license. No commit pin was claimed.
sources.scope_read: Full methodology §4, Algorithm 1, Appendix-A methodological details, results/limitations, and official repository README.
sources.objective_algorithm: LLM proposes executable initial-state, transition, observation, and reward components from state-free trajectories; particle-filtered observation-kernel score, execution diagnostics, and committee disagreement guide UCB-selected candidate refinement and final near-best selection.
sources.reported_result_population: Four MiniGrid environments with state-free offline trajectories; no cross-environment or non-MiniGrid evaluation.
sources.assumptions_failures: Hand-designed observation distance, manually collected offline trajectories, no cross-environment generalization test, and no evaluation outside MiniGrid. Kernel objective ranks models and is not marginal likelihood or truth.
sources.hswm_transfer_obligation: Most direct template for outcome-bound relation hypothesis ranking: retain proposal, score, diagnostic, uncertainty/disagreement, selected revision, and fresh-case test as distinct atoms; do not turn the score into Semantic Weight, evidence mass, or causal credit.

sources.title: Large Language Models Cannot Self-Correct Reasoning Yet
sources.authors: Jie Huang; Xinyun Chen; Swaroop Mishra; Huaixiu Steven Zheng; Adams Wei Yu; Xinying Song; Denny Zhou
sources.scope_read: Full experimental setup, oracle versus intrinsic correction results, prompt variants, analysis, and stated scope.
sources.objective_algorithm: Compare answer-review-revision with oracle labels that stop when correct versus intrinsic correction that asks the model itself whether to retain/revise.
sources.reported_result_population: Across the paper's tested reasoning benchmarks/models, intrinsic correction degraded while oracle stopping accounted for observed improvement.
sources.assumptions_failures: Bounded to the paper's 2023-era models, prompts, reasoning tasks, sample sizes and call budgets; it does not prove external-feedback or all future-model correction impossible.
sources.hswm_transfer_obligation: Require independently observed outcome/evaluator provenance and make no-op/retain an explicit candidate. Never promote a relation revision because the same LLM supplied its critique and acceptance rationale.
